subject: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria, timeline, and mitigation ladder
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@horizonanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria, timeline, and mitigation ladder

Evan / Claire — thanks again for a productive call this morning. I promised a concise post-call recap with explicit success criteria and next steps so your internal team can greenlight the pilot. Below is the proposed onramp plan. Please review and flag anything we should change.

1) High-level goal
- Validate Redwood delivering consistent <200ms median token latency for Horizon’s 512-token average inference workload at 5 qps sustained, with no more than 2% request error rate over a 7-day run.

2) Success criteria (must-pass)
- Latency: median per-token latency <= 200ms under pilot load profile.
- Stability: error rate <= 2% over 7-day window.
- Functional: sample prompts from your 50-test-set produce no major hallucinations (domain-critical checks defined in attached spreadsheet).
- Integration: secure VPC peering + KMS key exchange completed and verified.

3) Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize network checklist & sign pilot SOW (DocuSign link below).
- Week 1: infra setup (VPC/KMS), sample dataset ingestion (50 canonical prompts), and smoke tests. Owner: Aditya Rao.
- Week 2: ramp to sustained 5 qps, run 48-hour stability window. Owner: Olga Petrov.
- Week 3: full 7-day validation run, generate metrics report and qualitative review with Horizon. Owner: Ben Carter + Horizon SME.

4) Roles & escalation ladder (if a blocking issue appears)
- Primary SE: Aditya Rao (first touch).
- Sales lead: Ben Carter (commercial questions).
- On-call engineering escalation: Rishi Malhotra (if mitigation within SE scope fails within 4 business hours).
- Executive escalation: Lauren Bishop (if outage extends >24 hours impacting acceptance).

5) Known pre-flight dependencies from Horizon
- Provide test dataset and sample prompts (CSV) by EOD 2026-05-12.
- Network egress rules for our staging cluster (see attached checklist).

6) Attachments included
- HRZN-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (acceptance matrix)
- network-access-checklist.pdf

Immediate asks for Horizon: 1) confirm the acceptance criteria above, 2) share the 50-test-set by 2026-05-12, 3) confirm DocuSign review owner.

Thanks — I’ll queue the DocuSign SOW once you confirm the test-set owner.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@horizonanalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Santos <claire.santos@horizonanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T13:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria, timeline, and mitigation ladder

Hi Olga — thanks, this is clear and close to what we need. A few tweaks from our side:

- The 200ms median is acceptable, but can we also add P95 <= 500ms as a soft target?
- We will provide the 50-test-set by 2026-05-12; Claire will own that and will send the CSV.
- For security, our infosec asked for confirmation that you support customer-managed KMS and that logs can be retained for 90 days. Can Aditya confirm?

Also: we will need a minimal SOC2 artifact pack as part of procurement — can you attach the standard packet or point us to where it is?

Evan
Evan Liu
Director, Data Products, Horizon Analytics
evan.liu@horizonanalytics.com

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria, timeline, and mitigation ladder

Evan — quick confirmations from the infra side:

- Customer-managed KMS: supported. We will walk Claire through the KMS key import and grant steps during Week 1. Owner: Aditya.
- Logs: we can provide 90-day retention for request traces and aggregated metrics; request-level PII will be redacted by default unless you request additional retention.
- SOC2 artifacts: attaching a pointer to our partner portal (link below) and including a summary pack (I attached the network checklist earlier).

Mitigation ladder for expected blocker categories (short matrix):

1) Network/VPC blocked (high severity)
- Immediate mitigation: confirm port/access via temporary tunnel + run smoke tests using our probe cluster (target < 4 hours).
- Owner: Aditya Rao.
- Escalate to: Rishi Malhotra if not resolved within 4 business hours.

2) Model quality divergence (medium severity)
- Immediate mitigation: run fallback to verified model variant (quantized / lower-latency) and freeze acceptance tests while we investigate.
- Owner: Olga Petrov.
- Escalate to: Rishi Malhotra for root-cause and regression fix (timeline target: 48 hours).

3) Sustained error rate spike due to infra (critical)
- Immediate mitigation: divert traffic to dedicated capacity pool and enable circuit-breaker to keep errors <5%.
- Owner: Rishi Malhotra.
- Escalate to: Lauren Bishop if outage >24 hours or if commercial impact requires SLA concession.

I’ll also join your network kickoff call to walk through the checklist. Evan, can you propose two 30-minute windows tomorrow for the tunnel/network walkthrough?

— Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Ben

Date: 2026-05-18T09:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria, timeline, and mitigation ladder — next steps

Evan / Claire — wrapping this thread with final next steps and owners. Thanks for the confirmations earlier.

Action items:
- Claire: deliver 50-test-set CSV by COB 2026-05-18 (owner for test-set).
- Aditya: schedule network tunnel walkthrough (proposed windows sent separately).
- Ben: prepare SOW and attach light redline; route DocuSign once Claire confirms test-set.
- Olga: kick off staging run once VPC/KMS verified; produce Week 2 48-hour report.

Contingency note (mitigation ladder in practice): if network access remains blocked after initial tunnel attempt, we will execute a 24-hour temporary proxy plan (Aditya) and document the impact on acceptance timing. If the temporary proxy is insufficient and the 7-day validation cannot start within the agreed window, we will escalate to Lauren for SLA/credit discussions.

Files attached to this thread for your convenience: HRZN-poc-success-metrics.xlsx, network-access-checklist.pdf, pilot-scope-diagram.png

DocuSign SOW link (will be live after Ben uploads): https://www.docusign.com/HRZN-PILOT-AGREEMENT

Thanks all — I’ll follow up with calendar invites and the kickoff notes.
